title: Cloud Agent → Mac My Machines worker 연결
instruction: CEO 수동 작업 없음. Mac Cursor Agent가 순서대로 실행: (1) bash scripts/mac-install-worker-launchagent.sh (2) bash scripts/jarvis-run-mac-tasks.sh

cloud_connect.reason: usePrivateWorker=false at agent start — cannot retroattach
cloud_connect.ceo_action: cursor.com/agents → 새 Agent → Environment에서 My Machine 'macbook-pro-audiso' 선택
cloud_connect.alternative: Mac Cursor Agents Window에서 /remote-control (Remote Control handoff)

success_criteria: agent worker list shows macbook-pro-audiso online
CEO starts new Cloud Agent with My Machine selected
